name: set_time_test.k
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations (schedule Ref)(durations Ref)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((TimeSchedule (mk-TimeSchedule (availableTimes (Set Int))(meetingTime Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((DurationSet (mk-DurationSet (allowedDurations (Set Int))(taskDuration Int)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (sel-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations))
  (lift-TimeSchedule (sel-TimeSchedule TimeSchedule))
  (lift-DurationSet (sel-DurationSet DurationSet))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) TopLevelDeclarations
  (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-TimeSchedule ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TimeSchedule (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TimeSchedule ((this Ref)) TimeSchedule
  (sel-TimeSchedule (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-DurationSet ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-DurationSet (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-DurationSet ((this Ref)) DurationSet
  (sel-DurationSet (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-TimeSchedule ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TimeSchedule this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-DurationSet ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-DurationSet this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; -------------------------------------------
;   Getters for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; -------------------------------------------

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.schedule: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!schedule ((this Ref)) Ref
  (schedule (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.durations: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!durations ((this Ref)) Ref
  (durations (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; -----------------------------------
;   Getters for class TimeSchedule:
; -----------------------------------

; --- getters for TimeSchedule.availableTimes: ---

(define-fun TimeSchedule.availableTimes ((this Ref)) (Set Int)
  (availableTimes (deref-TimeSchedule this))
)

(define-fun TimeSchedule!availableTimes ((this Ref)) (Set Int)
  (availableTimes (deref-TimeSchedule this))
)

; --- getters for TimeSchedule.meetingTime: ---

(define-fun TimeSchedule!meetingTime ((this Ref)) Int
  (meetingTime (deref-TimeSchedule this))
)

; ----------------------------------
;   Getters for class DurationSet:
; ----------------------------------

; --- getters for DurationSet.allowedDurations: ---

(define-fun DurationSet.allowedDurations ((this Ref)) (Set Int)
  (allowedDurations (deref-DurationSet this))
)

(define-fun DurationSet!allowedDurations ((this Ref)) (Set Int)
  (allowedDurations (deref-DurationSet this))
)

; --- getters for DurationSet.taskDuration: ---

(define-fun DurationSet!taskDuration ((this Ref)) Int
  (taskDuration (deref-DurationSet this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; ---------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; ---------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-0-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-TimeSchedule (TopLevelDeclarations!schedule this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 0) :named _xkassert0))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-DurationSet (TopLevelDeclarations!durations this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv2 0) :named _xkassert1))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (TimeSchedule.availableTimes (TopLevelDeclarations!schedule this)) (store (store (store ((as const (Set Int)) false) 1765184400000 true) 1765188000000 true) 1765202400000 true))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv3 0) :named _xkassert2))

; --- Invariant 4: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv4 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (DurationSet.allowedDurations (TopLevelDeclarations!durations this)) (store (store (store (store ((as const (Set Int)) false) 1800000000 true) 3600000000 true) 5400000000 true) 7200000000 true))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv4 0) :named _xkassert3))



; -------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class TimeSchedule:
; -------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-TimeSchedule TimeSchedule)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun TimeSchedule.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (select (TimeSchedule!availableTimes this) (TimeSchedule!meetingTime this))
)

(assert (! (TimeSchedule.inv1 1) :named _xkassert4))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun TimeSchedule.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (>= (TimeSchedule!meetingTime this) 1765184400000)
)

(assert (! (TimeSchedule.inv2 1) :named _xkassert5))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun TimeSchedule.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (<= (TimeSchedule!meetingTime this) 1765213200000)
)

(assert (! (TimeSchedule.inv3 1) :named _xkassert6))



; ------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class DurationSet:
; ------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-2-DurationSet DurationSet)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun DurationSet.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (select (DurationSet!allowedDurations this) (DurationSet!taskDuration this))
)

(assert (! (DurationSet.inv1 2) :named _xkassert7))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun DurationSet.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (>= (DurationSet!taskDuration this) 1800000000)
)

(assert (! (DurationSet.inv2 2) :named _xkassert8))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun DurationSet.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (<= (DurationSet!taskDuration this) 7200000000)
)

(assert (! (DurationSet.inv3 2) :named _xkassert9))




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        0 (lift-TopLevelDeclarations const-0-TopLevelDeclarations))
        1 (lift-TimeSchedule const-1-TimeSchedule))
        2 (lift-DurationSet const-2-DurationSet))
  )
)
smtModel:

  (let ((a!1 (store (store (store ((as const (Array Int Bool)) false)
                                1765184400000
                                true)
                         1765188000000
                         true)
                  1765202400000
                  true)))
  (mk-TimeSchedule a!1 1765184400000)))
(define-fun const-2-DurationSet () DurationSet
  (let ((a!1 (store (store (store ((as const (Array Int Bool)) false)
                                1800000000
                                true)
                         3600000000
                         true)
                  5400000000
                  true)))
  (mk-DurationSet (store a!1 7200000000 true) 5400000000)))
(define-fun const-0-TopLevelDeclarations () TopLevelDeclarations
  (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 1 2))
(define-fun _xkassert7 () Bool
  (select (allowedDurations (sel-DurationSet (select heap 2)))
        (taskDuration (sel-DurationSet (select heap 2)))))

      (a!2 (store (store (store ((as const (Array Int Bool)) false)
                                1765184400000
                                true)
                         1765188000000
                         true)
                  1765202400000
                  true)))

(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)

                  1765202400000
